findings.title: Missing React key for Grafana rules in filtered list
findings.body: In FilterViewResults the rules.map destructures key but the grafana branch renders GrafanaRuleListItem without key={key} while the datasource branch passes it. Without stable keys React reuses DOM and component state incorrectly during infinite scroll and filter changes, causing wrong rows, lost focus, or actions opening for the wrong rule.

findings.title: Silence drawer never opens for Prometheus-only rules
findings.body: RuleActionsButtons now accepts prom-only Grafana rules with optional ruler rule and AlertRuleMenu enables Silence from prom abilities. handleSilence sets showSilenceDrawer true, but rendering is gated on rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) where rule is the optional ruler DTO. In the list view rule is undefined so the condition is always false, SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer never mounts and clicking Silence does nothing.

findings.title: Pause action hidden for Prometheus-only rules
findings.body: AlertRuleMenu computes canPause as OR of ruler and prom abilities to support the list view without ruler fetch, but the Pause menu item still requires rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule). When called from the new list with only promRule, rulerRule is undefined so Pause never renders even when the prom ability says it is supported and allowed, removing pause/unpause from the list.

findings.title: Delete action hidden for Prometheus-only rules
findings.body: canDelete is computed as OR of ruler and prom abilities, but the Delete menu item is gated on canDelete && rulerRule. With only promRule in the list view rulerRule is undefined so Delete never appears even with permission, making Grafana rules undeletable from the list. The handler signature also still requires a ruler DTO so no prom-aware delete path exists.

findings.title: Duplicate allowed for cloud rules via Grafana permissions
findings.body: useGrafanaPromRuleAbilities maps skipToken to undefined, and useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities still returns Duplicate as supported with allowed based on Grafana create permission even when rule is undefined. AlertRuleMenu calls it with skipToken for non-Grafana rules and ORs with the ruler result, so a user with Grafana create but without external write permission gets Duplicate enabled for Mimir/Loki/Cortex rules.

findings.title: Export disabled for Grafana recording rules
findings.body: In useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities ModifyExport is [isAlertingRule, exportAllowed] where isAlertingRule is true only for alerting type. The ruler version used isGrafanaManagedAlertRule which is true for both alerting and recording. As a result Grafana recording rules always report export unsupported and lose the Export menu item.

findings.title: Federated rules no longer treated as immutable
findings.body: useAllAlertRuleAbilities previously checked isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) to block Update/Delete/Pause for federated groups. It now delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities with only rulerRule and group identifier, which hardcodes isFederated to false. Federated rules now report edit and delete as supported, offering actions that must be blocked.

findings.title: Rule view link drops returnTo navigation state
findings.body: The previous list item built the detail href as /alerting/grafana/<uid>/view with a returnTo query so the detail page can navigate back to the list with filters. The new GrafanaRuleListItem builds the href without returnTo, so Back from rule details loses list context.
